modules.name: WARP
modules.description: Curved master clock: tempo that drifts, bars that bend, four related phase outputs

modules.name: CONTOUR
modules.description: Rhythms where a curve crosses levels, with an 8-phasor interference source. Runs from a phase ramp or free, up to audio rate

modules.name: MUTATE
modules.description: 8-track step drum sequencer that writes its own patterns and slowly rewrites them: ratchets, micro-timing, conditions, per-step sound locks, polymeter

modules.name: STRIKE
modules.description: Modal percussion: 32 tuned resonators that morph from wood to rubber, metal, glass and drum skin, plus a vowel (formant) mode. Up to 8 voices

modules.name: FMX
modules.description: Four-operator FM voice whose loudness and brightness follow a phase ramp or a trigger, up to audio-rate retriggering. Up to 8 voices

modules.name: CHAIN
modules.description: Four melody voices that pick each note from a table of likely next notes, with harmony rules between them (stay in key, thirds and sixths, contrary motion, no parallels, leap limit, pull to the root). Tables can be learned from a melody or painted

modules.name: SPLICE
modules.description: Cut-up and smear buffer: 16 seconds of stereo tape that stutters the slice that has just gone by, with repeats that speed up, change pitch, reverse and fade, or dissolve into grains

modules.name: DEPTH
modules.description: Reverb that places four stereo sources at different distances in one room: each gets its own pre-delay, air loss and early reflections, and all share a tail that can freeze or bloom

modules.name: VAULT
modules.description: Rolling capture and clip launcher for gates and CV: always records the last 64 bars of 8 lanes, KEEP copies the last bars into one of 64 clips, and clips play back following the current clock, thinned, transposed, reversed or windowed

modules.name: STEER
modules.description: Performance control: 8 macros that each move up to 16 parameters anywhere in the rack with their own range and curve, recordable macro gestures, 16 scenes that can launch VAULT clips, and a tree of whole-rack snapshots to morph between or wander through
